arguments.value: This agreement is between DOT COM LLC, OBA Seattle Software Developers, a Delaware limited liability company, and Pelican Delivers Inc. It starts on December 3, 2018 and continues until the developer’s services and work product are completed or the agreement is terminated, as the parties mutually agree for the project. Seattle Software Developers will design, develop, and deliver the Pelican Delivers Application Phase 1 and related services, deliverables, and documentation under one or more statements of work. Each statement of work sets the schedule, milestones, testing, and final delivery date, and Pelican Delivers must test deliverables and give written change requests within the stated time periods or the deliverables are deemed accepted. If a deliverable is rejected, the developer must fix the issues within the stated time, and the client may repeat the process or terminate the agreement if the developer does not correct them as required. Pelican Delivers must provide reasonable assistance and information needed for the work. Any additional services or changes must be handled through a written change order, with any fee and schedule impact to be evaluated and agreed in an amended statement of work or change order before the developer must perform the extra work. Pelican Delivers must pay the fees set out in each statement of work, along with any expenses if the statement of work says so, and may owe a bonus if the work is completed early as described in the statement of work. The completed software, deliverables, and documentation are treated as work made for hire, so Pelican Delivers owns them, while Seattle Software Developers keeps ownership of its own preexisting technology. Both parties must keep confidential information secret and destroy it when the agreement ends, and either party may seek injunctive relief for a breach of confidentiality. The developer is an independent contractor, the relationship is non-exclusive, and the agreement is governed by Washington law. Either party may terminate the agreement without cause on two weeks’ written notice, or immediately for material breach, nonpayment, confidentiality violations, or illegal conduct. If the agreement ends, Pelican Delivers must pay amounts due for work performed, the developer must refund any non-accrued prepaid fees, and the developer may provide paid termination assistance at the stated hourly rate if requested.
